{-# LANGUAGE ForeignFunctionInterface #-}
module EmailService where

import Foreign.Ptr
import Foreign.ForeignPtr
import Foreign.C.String
import Foreign.C.Types
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Control.Exception (bracket, finally, mask_)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

-- FFI bindings to libcurl-based email sender
foreign import ccall "create_smtp_handle" c_create_smtp_handle :: IO (Ptr ())
foreign import ccall "&destroy_smtp_handle" c_destroy_smtp_handle :: FunPtr (Ptr () -> IO ())
foreign import ccall "smtp_send" c_smtp_send :: Ptr () -> CString -> CString -> CString -> IO CInt
foreign import ccall "smtp_set_auth" c_smtp_set_auth :: Ptr () -> CString -> CString -> IO CInt

data Role = Admin | Manager | User | Guest deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data EmailContext = EmailContext
  { ctxHandle    :: ForeignPtr ()
  , ctxRole      :: Role
  , ctxQuota     :: IORef Int
  , ctxSentCount :: IORef Int
  , ctxFinalized :: IORef Bool
  }

data SendResult = SendOk | SendFailed String | SendDenied String deriving (Show)

rolePermissions :: Map.Map Role [String]
rolePermissions = Map.fromList
  [ (Admin,   ["send", "send_bulk", "manage_templates", "view_logs"])
  , (Manager, ["send", "send_bulk", "view_logs"])
  , (User,    ["send"])
  , (Guest,   [])
  ]

hasPermission :: Role -> String -> Bool
hasPermission role perm = case Map.lookup role rolePermissions of
  Nothing    -> False
  Just perms -> perm `elem` perms

quotaForRole :: Role -> Int
quotaForRole Admin   = 10000
quotaForRole Manager = 1000
quotaForRole User    = 100
quotaForRole Guest   = 0

createEmailContext :: Role -> String -> String -> IO EmailContext
createEmailContext role username password = do
  rawPtr <- c_create_smtp_handle
  fptr <- newForeignPtr c_destroy_smtp_handle rawPtr
  withCString username $ \cUser ->
    withCString password $ \cPass ->
      c_smtp_set_auth rawPtr cUser cPass
  quotaRef <- newIORef (quotaForRole role)
  sentRef  <- newIORef 0
  finRef   <- newIORef False
  return $ EmailContext fptr role quotaRef sentRef finRef

sendEmail :: EmailContext -> String -> String -> String -> IO SendResult
sendEmail ctx to subject body = do
  finalized <- readIORef (ctxFinalized ctx)
  when finalized $ error "Context already finalized"
  unless (hasPermission (ctxRole ctx) "send") $
    return (SendDenied "Insufficient permissions")
  remaining <- readIORef (ctxQuota ctx)
  if remaining <= 0
    then return (SendDenied "Quota exceeded")
    else do
      modifyIORef' (ctxQuota ctx) (subtract 1)
      modifyIORef' (ctxSentCount ctx) (+1)
      result <- withForeignPtr (ctxHandle ctx) $ \ptr ->
        withCString to $ \cTo ->
          withCString subject $ \cSubj ->
            withCString body $ \cBody ->
              c_smtp_send ptr cTo cSubj cBody
      if result == 0
        then return SendOk
        else return (SendFailed $ "SMTP error code: " ++ show result)

sendBulkEmails :: EmailContext -> [(String, String, String)] -> IO [SendResult]
sendBulkEmails ctx recipients = do
  unless (hasPermission (ctxRole ctx) "send_bulk") $
    return [SendDenied "Bulk send not permitted"]
  mapM (\(to, subj, body) -> sendEmail ctx to subj body) recipients

-- Transfer ownership of email context between users during role escalation
transferContext :: EmailContext -> Role -> IO EmailContext
transferContext oldCtx newRole = do
  finalized <- readIORef (ctxFinalized oldCtx)
  when finalized $ error "Cannot transfer finalized context"
  writeIORef (ctxFinalized oldCtx) True
  -- Release the old context's handle
  finalizeForeignPtr (ctxHandle oldCtx)
  -- Create new context reusing the underlying connection for efficiency
  -- BUG: We copy the ForeignPtr from oldCtx, but we already finalized it above.
  -- When the new context's ForeignPtr is GC'd, it will call destroy again.
  newQuotaRef <- newIORef (quotaForRole newRole)
  newSentRef  <- newIORef 0
  newFinRef   <- newIORef False
  return $ EmailContext (ctxHandle oldCtx) newRole newQuotaRef newSentRef newFinRef

finalizeContext :: EmailContext -> IO ()
finalizeContext ctx = do
  alreadyDone <- readIORef (ctxFinalized ctx)
  unless alreadyDone $ do
    writeIORef (ctxFinalized ctx) True
    finalizeForeignPtr (ctxHandle ctx)

-- Example workflow: user gets promoted, context transferred
promotionWorkflow :: String -> String -> IO ()
promotionWorkflow username password = do
  ctx <- createEmailContext User username password
  _ <- sendEmail ctx "team@example.com" "Hello" "Test message"
  -- User gets promoted to Manager
  newCtx <- transferContext ctx Manager
  _ <- sendBulkEmails newCtx [("all@example.com", "Announcement", "I'm a manager now")]
  finalizeContext newCtx
  -- At this point, GC of oldCtx's ForeignPtr OR newCtx's ForeignPtr
  -- will trigger double-free of the underlying SMTP handle
  return ()
